name: Most Popular AI Tools

sources.title: Homepage — curated AI directory, 'hand-checked listings', Submit Tool nav, sponsored section labelled
Submit page — 'List your AI tool'; form is JS-rendered, plans match the pricing page
Pricing — Basic $10 one-time, Growth $39 one-time, Pro custom; all one-time payments with dofollow backlinks

requirements: AI tools only; every submission is 'hand-tested' — the team signs up, verifies pricing, and confirms free tiers actually work without a card

All listing tiers are paid one-time: Basic $10 (name, description, link, category, dofollow backlink, ~5 business days), Growth $39 (detailed profile, logo, 1 screenshot, ~7 business days), Pro custom (full profile, homepage feature 7 days, up to 5 screenshots/video, 24–48h priority)
Dead sites, abandoned products, and broken links are rejected
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category, pricing model
Logo and screenshots (Growth: logo + 1 screenshot; Pro: up to 5 screenshots + video demos)
Social profile links (Pro tier links X/LinkedIn/GitHub)
A working free tier or accurate pricing — they verify claims by signing up
Payment method for the $10/$39/custom one-time fee
workflow: Pick Basic, Growth, or Pro and fill the short form (name, description, features, screenshots, pricing)
Team tests core features and verifies pricing; they email if anything needs clarifying
Listing goes live with a verified badge after review
watchFor: No free tier — even the Basic listing costs $10
Growth's 7-day review is slower than Basic's 5 days despite costing more — odd ordering on the pricing table
Featured & Sponsored placements exist — organic ranking is claimed to be real-traffic based
Affiliate disclosure site-wide: outbound links may be affiliate-wrapped
Small directory (~26 tools in FAQ count vs category counts — young site)
countsAsLive: The tool gets a public page under mostpopularaitools.com/tools (or category pages) with a verified badge after review
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the JS-rendered submit form
Refund policy if a submission is rejected after payment
Whether a login (Sign In link exists) is required to submit
